clue.text: An eagle tried (and Hercules managed) to do this to Prometheus

definitions.text: An eagle tried (and Hercules managed) to do this to Prometheus

explanation.surface: A retelling of the Prometheus myth: the eagle's daily attack and Hercules' rescue.

explanation.definitionFit: To free or rescue someone is one meaning, and read as de-liver it means removing the liver.
